ov: ICOM ID-50A VHF/UHF Multi-Function D-Star Handheld Transceivers The ICOM ID-50A is a compact, dual band 2m/70cm digital transceiver that brings the fun of the D-STAR to life and includes functions to enhance your QSO experience making the ID-50A the perfect travel companion. The Band Scope and Waterfall displays can visually show active channels with a wide span and timeline, making it easy to find active channels by sight. The Dual-Watch function doubles QSO opportunities to monitor VHF/VHF, VHF/UHF, and UHF/UHF bands at the same time and can receive both FM and Air bands. The built-in GPS receiver displays the current grid square information and this GPS position data can be used for Position Auto Reply, Near Repeater Search and GPS log functions. Connecting your ID-50A to a D-STAR (Digital Smart Technology for Amateur Radio) network allows you to call a friend in another city or in other regions around the world. Build your own internet gateway to access the DSTAR repeater network and use Terminal Mode to send voice and data over the internet to D-STAR repeaters and Access Point Mode to connect to other D-Star radios, even in an area with no D-STAR repeaters nearby. The DSTAR DV mode can send not only voice but also image data. Download the ST-ID50A/W picture Utility Software from the ICOM website and import photos from a smart device into the ID-50A to exchange photos and QSO cards with others. A multi-function USB Type-C port is included for charging the ID-50A as well as for PC programming, reading and write contents to the microSD card, Terminal and Access Point mode support and CI-V control using an industry standard USB Type-C™ cable (sold separately). ov: ICOM IC-V3500B Black Edition 2M VHF FM Mobile Transceivers ICOM IC-V3500B Black Edition 2M VHF FM Mobile Transceivers combine a durable modern design with clear, intuitive operation and updated display technology. The latest Black Edition introduces a high‑visibility black inverted LCD, providing enhanced contrast and readability in a wide range of lighting conditions. The dark background improves clarity for frequency, channel, and function indicators, making the transceiver easier to monitor at a glance whether driving in bright daylight or operating at night. These transceivers deliver a full 65W of selectable RF output power for the 144–148MHz transmit range, backed by a large heatsink that stabilizes thermal performance during extended operation. They also offer wideband receive capability from 136–174MHz, providing wideband VHF receive coverage for expanded monitoring capabilityAudio performance remains a core strength, with the internal speaker producing 4.5W of loud, articulate sound thanks to improved frequency response and an optimized acoustic opening. Instant volume‑boost and one‑touch mute options provide quick level control when conditions change. The IC-V3500B transceivers also include emergency call and alert functions, which transmit alternating alarm tones and live microphone audio while sounding a local alarm from the speaker. For memory and scanning flexibility, the IC‑V3500B series provides 207 memory channels with alphanumeric naming, dynamic bank link scanning, CTCSS/DTCS encoding and decoding, and priority watch capability. Weather‑channel reception and weather alerts are available, further enhancing situational awareness. Construction remains robust, meeting MIL‑STD‑810G environmental standards. Configuration is streamlined through free PC programming software, and many functions can be controlled directly from a compatible remote‑control microphone, simplifying installation and day‑to‑day use in mobile environments.
